metadata.description: Nibble: small, safe bites of change for repos you do not know. A five-step debugging loop that maps, scans, traces, fixes, and commits.

plugins.name: nibble
plugins.description: Land in an unfamiliar repo and change it safely, one small bite at a time: map the code, scan for real defects, trace the root cause, make the smallest fix, commit it atomically. Language and agent agnostic.
